title: Texting and walking made illegal
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Is texting while walking dangerous enough to justify making it illegal?
Where should the line be between personal responsibility and government regulation?
Would fines actually change people's behaviour, or would public education work better?
Are pedestrians using phones more dangerous to themselves or to other people?
What other everyday behaviour involving phones deserves more attention?
